sources.qualifications: Empty relation nonreflexivity needs a nonempty carrier. General closure existence needs intersection and admissible-extension conditions. Rearranged sequences with repetition give multisets, not fixed-size subsets. Directed one-way reachability is not an equivalence. An oldest-living-relative map also needs existence and a uniquely determined selected output; representative independence alone does not supply those assumptions.
